fields.label: Delivery Return From a Credit Note

fields.options:
The standing rule is that a credit note means goods physically coming back, so a return of delivered goods is raised on the Delivery Note (Create > Sales Return, tick Issue Credit Note).

Tick the box below to also allow the reverse order: raise the credit note against the invoice first, then use Create > Delivery Note on that credit note to bring the stock back. The delivery return is linked to both the credit note and the original delivery note.

Leave it off unless the branch actually works that way. With it on, a credit note for delivered goods can be submitted before any stock has come back.

fields.description: Adds Create > Delivery Note to a submitted sales return, and allows that credit note to be raised before the goods come back.
fields.label: Allow Delivery Note From a Sales Return
